articleTitle: Automatic Monitoring and Detection of Hot Spot on Photovoltaic Panel Based on YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Computing and Analytics (ACOMPA)
abstract: The research contented the development of an automatic monitoring system for photovoltaic (PV) panel array with hot-spot detection capability through applying YOLOv5 deep learning model on PV thermal images. The system uses a sliding mechanism and automatic capture thermal images at each panel position with a thermal camera and a controller system. The designed system afterward is used to collect an image dataset for training a deep learning model of YOLOv5 architecture to detect hot-spot area from the panel's thermal image. The training result of the YOLOv5 model from a dataset of 120 images with train/valid ratio of 90/30 gives out the accuracy of 81% of hot-spot detection. The trained model is integrated into the system operation to automatically perform daily monitoring for panels in the photovoltaic array.

articleTitle: Evaluation System of Student's Concentration Using Deep Learning-Based Head-Pose Estimation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Computing and Analytics (ACOMPA)
abstract: For online learning, it is difficult to evaluate the concentration of students when they are studying online. This paper will present an evaluation system of student's concentration for online learning platform. The proposed system uses the deep learning-based head-pose estimation algorithm to determine the concentration of the students. In addition, closed eye detection is applied to detect distraction of students. The experimental results show that the proposed system can efficiently detect student's concentration.

articleTitle: Designing StyleGAN2 Model for Generating 2D Pokemon Character
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Computing and Analytics (ACOMPA)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a 2D image generation model using StyleGAN2 applied in the creative design of publications for entertainment purposes. There are only 898 Pokemons created throughout 26 years. Therefore, we focus on generating new Pokemon to signicantly reduce their cost. We built a dataset of approximately 800 images on Kaggle, applied DiffGANAugment, and trained them using the styleGAN2 model. The Frchet inception distance (FID) score evaluates the generated images' quality. The results show that the proposed model achieves an FID score of 53.23 after 33 epochs that are applicable in real hardware.

articleTitle: An Automatic Diagnosis System of Rice Leaf Diseases Based on ResNet-50 Architecture
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Computing and Analytics (ACOMPA)
abstract: Rice diseases exert a substantial detrimental influence on both the yield and quality of rice crops. An accurate and expeditious identification of rice diseases is important to minimize the adverse consequences associated with them. At present, identifying rice diseases mainly relies on manual methods, including visual inspection of disease spots on rice leaves. In this study, we proposed an automated diagnostic method for detecting rice leaf diseases using ResNet-50 convolutional neural network (CNN), aiming to enhance the efficiency and convenience of disease detection. The image dataset of diseases in rice leaves was obtained from Kaggle and consists of three distinct forms of diseases: leaf blast, hispa, and brown spot. In addition, several image augmentation methods were implemented to enhance the size of the dataset and avoid the overfitting problem. The ResNet-50 CNN was employed to create the required prediction model using a substantial dataset of 3737 images representing three distinct categories of rice leaf diseases, including leaf blast (1200 images), hispa (1437 images), and brown spot (1100 images). The ResNet-50 model was optimized by tuning different hyper-parameters, resulting in very high average accuracy for both the training dataset and the test dataset of 98.64% and 98.33%, respectively, by running 85 epochs. The trained model was deployed using Gradio web application for the purpose of diagnosing diseases in rice leaves.

articleTitle: Deviation Backfilling: A Robust Backfilling Scheme for Improving the Efficiency of Job Scheduling on High Performance Computing Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Computing and Analytics (ACOMPA)
abstract: The Big Data era has led to the rapid development of modern sciences. Making effective use of extremely large amounts of collected data is putting extremely urgent demands on High Performance Computing (HPC) systems, especially the resource allocation process, which is commonly managed by the job scheduler. Despite the potential for improved scheduling outcomes offered by modern algorithms, these systems still continue to favor the FCFS and EASY backfilling approach due to its straightforward implementation and fair resource allocation. In this paper, we propose a novel and robust backfilling scheme called Deviation Backfilling to enhance the efficiency of job scheduling on HPC systems while maintaining user fairness. Combined with the job runtime prediction method using kNN, the Deviation Backfilling uses the deviation between user estimates and system prediction as the delay threshold for the first job at the backfilling queue. Our experimental results show that Deviation Backfilling outperforms existing scheduling strategies regarding performance metrics on real-world datasets. This performance improvement also signifies the capability to motivate users to offer more accurate estimates for assisting the HPC scheduling procedures.

articleTitle: Design a Smart Membrane House System and Build Melon Farm Management Software to Develop High-Tech Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Computing and Analytics (ACOMPA)
abstract: Farmers in Vietnam do not have the habit of using smartphones or computers to control the situation of the farm. There are many intelligent farm systems researched and applied by developed countries. Still, they face many difficulties, such as expensive costs, import barriers import, problems in use due to language, or not being suitable for the scale of agricultural production in the locality. To use these systems, farm owners must make many adjustments to make the system ideal for farming needs, but the cost and effort are prohibitive. Vietnam's hi-tech melon growing model has gradually made vital development steps in the past few years. The authors have researched and built an intelligent membrane model and designed management tools to optimize cultivation. The research team made the system to support the management and administration of the management department and reports and updates of workers on the management website and the mobile application. This method can be widely deployed in Vietnam to help farmers optimize crop management.

articleTitle: Data Processing for a Vision-Imu Integration to Estimate Position
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Computing and Analytics (ACOMPA)
abstract: In this paper, the data smoothing technique is applied to the location estimation by Kalman filter. Estimates of the foot's trajectory in three dimensions (3D) are based on data obtained by the Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) and are compensated (corrected) by updating using information from an image sensor such as a camera. Camera-based information is estimated using vision techniques, image processing techniques, and pose estimation algorithms. Two indirect Kalman filters (iKFs) including forward filter and backward (reverse) filter are designed. Smoothing technique employs two designed iKFs in order to increase the accuracy and reduce velocity and position estimation errors. A physical system for experimentally verifying the effectiveness of the smoothing technique is designed with suitable experimental scenarios. The experimental results are synthesized and visualized, showing that the estimation accuracy increases when applying the smoothing technique. Digitizer measuring device is used as groundtruth to evaluate the accuracy of the smoothing technique. The error between the groundtruth and the smoothed estimation is found to be 4.8 ± 9.1 millimetters.

articleTitle: Multi-Head Time Series Prediction by Decomposition and LSTM-Self-Attention-LSTM Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Computing and Analytics (ACOMPA)
abstract: Time series prediction needs advanced techniques in order to procedure a prediction result as accurate as possible. Machine learning and deep learning are known as the most sophisticated techniques in the field of time series prediction. These techniques can provide a source of tools for this prediction task. That is the reason for that in this paper we propose a new hybrid machine learning model having the structure ‘Decomposition-LSTM-Self-Attention-LSTM’ to predict the future value of time series. Our model contains three stages: analyzing, predicting, and synthesizing. For each stages, different layers and techniques were used to obtain the best prediction results. Our proposed model has been successfully applied to a real financial dataset from the Ho Chi Minh Stock Exchange. The results show that the proposed model exhibits higher forecasting accuracy than other benchmark models such as SVR, LSTM, and ConvLSTM.

articleTitle: Pedestrian Detection Using YOLO with Improved Attention Module
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Computing and Analytics (ACOMPA)
abstract: Pedestrian detection is considered as an important component of intelligent traffic management systems. This paper presents an improved Yolov5 's framework for pedestrian detection. We propose two new attention modules for Yolov5 architecture to highlight significant information. First, the modified Efficient Channel Attention (M-ECA) was applied in the backbone of Yolo network to collect the useful features. Second, the modified Global Attention Mechanism (M-GAM) was inserted in the head of Yolo network to enhance feature representation. Thanks to two new improved attention modules, the proposed model achieves the high accuracy for overlapped pedestrian detection in crowded streets. The proposed model was trained with Penn-Fudan dataset. The experimental result shows that the proposed model has better detection accuracy and mAP, comparing to the original Yolov5.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Deep CNN-BiLSTM Model on Diverse Datasets
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Computing and Analytics (ACOMPA)
abstract: In the field of network intrusion detection, a wide range of machine learning and deep learning models have been developed, including the successful CNN-BiLSTM [1] model, which has shown promising results on datasets such as NSL-KDD and UNSW-NB15. Building upon these achievements, we conduct an evaluation of the CNN-BiLSTM model on the ToNIoT and CICIDS2018 datasets to provide a comprehensive and objective assessment of its effectiveness in network attack detection. By testing the model's performance on these datasets, we aim to further validate its efficacy and establish its applicability in real-world scenarios.

articleTitle: A Personalized Meal Recommendation Approach For Smart Refrigerator
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Computing and Analytics (ACOMPA)
abstract: This paper presents a food recommendation system that utilizes the multiple regression formula to suggest suitable dishes and meals. The system incorporates several independent variables, including ingredient availability (consisting of ingredient weights and expiration weights), user ratings, user health conditions, and nutritional responsiveness. The dependent variable is the appropriateness of the suggested dish and meal choices for the users. By employing the multiple regression formula, our system aims to understand the relationships between these variables and develop an effective method for providing personalized food and meal recommendations. The results contribute to the field of personalized food recommendation and provide insights for enhancing user satisfaction and promoting healthy eating habits.

articleTitle: Efficient Multi-Class Object Re-Identification Approach with A Unified Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Computing and Analytics (ACOMPA)
abstract: Re-identification (ReID) is a critical field in com-puter vision. In previous studies, ReID models have primarily focused on identifying specific objects, such as persons or vehi-cles. However, handling diverse object types poses a significant challenge in real-world applications. This paper proposes an advanced multi-task <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$ReID$</tex> model that identifies and classifies multiple object types within a single architecture. The proposed method allows our model to achieve high performance and gener-alizability across various object categories, including humans and vehicles. Our proposed model combines the strengths of multiple loss functions and incorporates several supporting techniques. We evaluate our model using two popular datasets, Market-l50l and VeRi-776. Our proposed model achieves 97.8% Rank@1 on the VeRi-776 dataset and 96.7% Rank@1 on the Market-l50l dataset in single-task training and evaluation. With our multi-class object re-identification approach, we simultaneously achieved an accuracy of 100% for the classification problem, 95.3% Rank@1 using the evaluation without classification information method, 95.4 % Rank @ 1 using the evaluation based on the classification method on the VeRi-776 dataset, and 9S.2% Rank@1 on the Market-l50l dataset. Code is available at this https URL.

articleTitle: An Improved Fuzzy Support Vector Machine Algorithm for Highly Imbalanced Datasets in the Co-Authorship Recommendation Problem
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Computing and Analytics (ACOMPA)
abstract: The co-authorship recommendation problem aims to suggest authors join research groups based on their research topics, expertise, and previous collaborations. To address this problem, we first model it as a co-authorship network, where each author is represented as a vertex, and collaborations between authors are represented as edges. This allows us to generate two-class imbalanced datasets derived from the co-authorship networks. We then propose an adaptive weight adjustment algorithm based on FSVM-CIL to classify highly imbalanced two-class datasets. To evaluate the performance of our algorithm, we conducted experiments using self-built co-authorship datasets of various sizes and imbalance ratios. Our experimental results show that our algorithm outperformed FSVM-CIL in solving the co-authorship recommendation problem.

articleTitle: Computer Vision Application in Management of Vehicle Speed in Factory Area
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Computing and Analytics (ACOMPA)
abstract: This paper presents a solution for managing vehicle speeds in specific areas such as factories or industrial facilities. Firstly, the videos, captured by fixed cameras, are processed to extract and detect vehicles by the fifth version You Only Look Once (YOLOv5). Then, the tracking-by-detection method, namely Strong Simple Online Real Time Tracking (StrongSORT), is used to track vehicle trajectories across consecutive frames by maintaining an identifier assigned to each vehicle. Next, these models' output results are obtained to estimate vehicle speeds. Two-speed estimation methods, namely Touch-two-frame and Distance-in-line, which we called C2V, KCKH respectively, in this study, are conducted and compared in various data contexts and parameters such as distance between two lines in the C2V and the number of calculated frames in KCKH method. Finally, over-speed vehicles are identified and sent to the Telegram application for the violation storage. The experimental results show that the speed measurement results in the C2V method yield higher accuracy when compared to the KCKH method. While the lowest RMSE of C2V is 0.93 (km/h), the lowest RMSE of KCKH is 4.83 (km/<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$h$</tex>). Furthermore, in the C2V method, when changing the calculated distance or the rotation angle of the camera, the obtained results do not differ too much.

articleTitle: Deep Inductive Transfer Learning Approach for Network Attacks Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Computing and Analytics (ACOMPA)
abstract: In recent years, we have been witness to a remarkable surge in technological advancements, accompanied by an unprecedented influx of network data within mobile and IoT applications. Consequently, the exponential rise in network connections has given rise to a concealed threat of potential network breaches. In order to address this danger, it is imperative that we actively strive to devise more effective techniques for monitoring network traffic. A significant challenge in identifying network attacks is their constantly evolving nature, necessitating an adaptable learning approach that can keep pace with these rapid changes. The remarkable advancements in AI/ML research provide a commendable and comprehensive approach to address the challenge of network intrusion detection. In this article, we propose a Transfer Learning model and undertake experiments on simulated network dataset to demonstrate the model's capacity to detect anomalous packets while successfully retaining old knowledge. To construct dataset, we build a VLAN to meticulously simulate various network attacks and meticulously analyze simulated attack packets using an IDS tool named Suricata.

articleTitle: A Communication Model for Different IOT Devices in Smart Home Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Computing and Analytics (ACOMPA)
abstract: With the growth of IoT technology, managing intelligent homes has become complex due to the increasing number of devices, and the difference of control systems from many vendors. It becomes difficult to manage and maintain various devices with different communication protocol, leading to high costs and excessive energy consumption. To address these challenges, there is a need for a common communication standard that allows different devices can be integrated in to a control system. Implementing such a standard would significantly improve the efficiency and sustainability of technology, ensuring that it remains accessible and beneficial for all users. In this paper, we propose communication and control model to integrate devices from different manufacturers into a single system while still ensuring manufacturers' benefits and production. A system of different devices featuring from simple functions to complex ones for smart home is implemented to analyze the effectiveness of the proposed model. This project utilizes common communication technologies such as WiFi and Bluetooth. Ultimately, it presents an efficient communication model that can be expanded effectively.

articleTitle: Towards Safer T-Junctions: Unveiling Crash Causes Through Comprehensive Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Computing and Analytics (ACOMPA)
abstract: Ensuring road safety continues to be a prominent global issue, with a notable proportion of road crashes occurring at intersections, particularly T-junctions. Despite efforts to mitigate this problem, existing remedies have frequently demonstrated limited efficacy, primarily due to a lack of comprehensive identification of the root causes of these crashes. This research endeavor seeks to redefine the series of events, influential elements, and underlying factors leading to traffic crashes at suburban T-junctions by employing advanced techniques in traffic crash reconstruction and in-depth mathematical data analysis. In the initial phase, crash data will be reconstructed using the HVE software to replicate the event sequence and redefine the contributing factors that lead to various levels of severity and the fundamental causes of these specific crashes. Finally, the Action Point Angle of Sight (APAS) mathematical formula is applied to conduct a deeper analysis before considering suitable countermeasures. The outcomes demonstrate that using HVE and APAS together is practical for studying rear-end and sideswipe collisions at suburban T-type intersections. Consequently, this allows for identifying appropriate countermeasures to enhance traffic safety at T-junctions in suburban areas. These findings are further translated into practical recommendations for academic researchers, policymakers, and practitioners. Specifically, this research guides these stakeholders in selecting appropriate methodologies for crash reconstruction and identifying evidence-based solutions to enhance traffic safety within T-junctions and other types of intersections in Vietnam.

articleTitle: MediFind - A Medicine Detection Framework for Vietnamese Medical Prescription
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Computing and Analytics (ACOMPA)
abstract: The pharmaceutical industry in Vietnam faces a significant challenge due to the time-consuming and inaccurate manual operational protocols. This results in incorrect pharmaceutical administration and antibiotic resistance, seriously affecting patient health. However, the implementation of Optical Character Recognition (OCR) can help automate the extraction of medication information from prescriptions, leading to stream-lined drug administration and reduced errors. In this study, drug misuse patterns are analyzed, a novel method for extracting medication names from Vietnamese prescriptions is introduced, and an app named “MediFind” is created to enhance accessibility. This innovative solution enhances pharmaceutical practices and streamlines drug administration.

articleTitle: Deflection Prediction of Multi-Dimensional Functionally Graded Plate with Variable Thickness on Elastic Foundation Using Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Computing and Analytics (ACOMPA)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to analyze and predict the central deflection of the multi-directional functionally graded plate with variable thickness on an elastic Winkler foundation. The finite element analysis with mixed interpolation of tensorial components of the 4-node (MITC4) is implemented in order to eliminate the theoretically shear locking phenomenon existing. Furthermore, the influences of the variable thickness functions (uniform, non-uniform linear, and non-uniform non-linear), material properties, length-to-thickness ratio, boundary conditions, and elastic parameters on the plate response are investigated and discussed in detail through several numerical examples. Finally, a deep neural network technique is learned to predict the non-dimensional deflections of multi-directional functionally graded plates based on more than 20,000 dataset collected from the analytical solution obtained in this paper and some from existing literature. By performing both neutral network and computational analysis, the accuracy of non-dimensional central deflection is provided for multi-directional functionally graded plates with various variable thicknesses. Therefore, the deep neural network model shows that it is a powerful technique capable of handling an extensive database and different vital parameters in engineering applications.

articleTitle: Message from General Chairs ACOMPA 2023
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Computing and Analytics (ACOMPA)
abstract: The International Conference on Advanced COMPuting and Analytics (ACOMPA) is an annual international forum for academics, engineers, practitioners and research students to exchange their ideas, techniques, methods, and state-of-the-art applications for advanced computing & analytics. Initially formed as a scientific venue for high-performance computing & advanced applications, the conference kept expanding and had a pedigree of attracting international and Vietnamese participants who are all interested in advanced topics of computer science & engineering. The first occurrence of ACOMPA was dated back to as early as 2007.
